fusions.name: Fluff Burst
fusions.desc: Shakes a cloud of loose down through a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 10 damage to everything in it, stunning each for 0.8 seconds and leaving it [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Unpicked Seam
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target: a peck unpicks it for 8 damage, using it up and adding half its remaining damage to the blow.

fusions.name: Downy Bandage
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

fusions.name: Quilted Plumage
fusions.desc: Conjures a quilted coat over your feathers: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 10%, and 5% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it. The coat itself adds 3% armour.
